Post-doc in artificial intelligence / spatial epidemiology

Description

Institution: IHU Sepsis is a hospital–university research institute dedicated to advancing the understanding of sepsis and developing innovative strategies for prevention. The institute brings together experts in medicine, epidemiology, data science, and biology, with a strong focus on translational public health impact.

Project Overview

Within the framework of a national research project, the postdoctoral researcher will investigate spatial variations in sepsis incidence across France using large-scale public ecological datasets (e.g. INSEE, ATMO, DREES, Santé Publique France). The project combines advanced spatial analysis and state-of-the-art artificial intelligence methods to identify territorial risk patterns and underlying ecological determinants.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage large territorial ecological databases (social, environmental, and health data).
• Perform classical and advanced spatial analyses to identify high-risk areas.
• Develop predictive and explanatory models using:
• Machine learning
• Bayesian spatial and spatio-temporal models
• Deep learning and spatio-temporal AI
• Graph-based models

• Produce high-quality maps, visualizations, and interactive dashboards.
• Publish results in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences.

Candidate Profile

• PhD in spatial epidemiology, data science for health, computer science, or a related field.
• Strong expertise in deep learning, spatial and spatio-temporal modeling and AI applied to public health or geospatial data.
• Proficiency in Python and GIS tools (QGIS, ArcGIS).
• Ability to work independently in a multidisciplinary research environment.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English (French is an asset but not required).

Duration: 24-month postdoctoral contract, full-time.

Location: UVSQ, Paris-Saclay
